input.query: category:research paper van den Berg Lessard Mischaikow validated continuation radii polynomials uniform contraction parameter dependent nonlinear solution curves
input.objective: Find original research papers, preferably author PDFs or arXiv, that state uniform residual and derivative bounds proving an entire continuation segment and local uniqueness. Capture exact theorem and radii-polynomial conditions, not general introductions.

input.query: category:research paper Rump Krawczyk interval nonlinear equations componentwise weighted maximum norm block contraction verified unique solution inclusion theorem
input.objective: Find primary mathematical papers with explicit finite-dimensional interval inclusion, approximate inverse and componentwise contraction hypotheses. Prefer original author papers with accessible theorem statements; exclude software advertisements.

input.query: category:research paper validated a posteriori Newton Kantorovich bounds implicit time step stiff chemical reaction kinetics conservation positivity nonlinear source
input.objective: Find primary work connecting actual residual/Jacobian bounds to a certified implicit stiff source step or continuation, especially conservative reaction or radiation systems. Distinguish numerical robustness experiments from rigorous existence or uniqueness certificates.

input.searchQuestion: Which primary papers establish quantitative a posteriori validated continuation of parameter-dependent nonlinear equations using radii polynomials, componentwise Krawczyk bounds or Newton-Kantorovich estimates, with conditions applicable to a finite-dimensional stiff conservative radiation and ionization source step?

input.query: category:research paper Siegfried Rump Verified Solution of Large Systems and Global Optimization Problems publication 1995
input.objective: Identify the original publication venue, year and page range of the author-hosted Ru95b.pdf paper. Prefer author bibliography or publisher metadata; do not infer its year from filename.

deduplication: Q1 McGill and Rutgers validated-continuation PDFs are versions of Day-Lessard-Mischaikow, one work.
Q2/Q4 Rump Ru95b and its publisher, institutional and Exa-catalog pages are one work; original author PDF read once.
The 2021 van den Berg-Queirolo framework appears in both Exa and SciSpace; screened, not separately counted as an adopted theorem source.
selection: L06-01 supplies uniform parameter-tube and same-root gluing conditions.
L06-02 supplies the componentwise weighted contraction theorem.
L06-03 supplies approximate-inverse/Krawczyk enclosure and rounding scope.
not_selected: Chemical kinetics positivity/Patankar results concern different discrete maps; no transfer to the fixed backward-Euler moving source is assumed.
The chemical-vapor-deposition talk and solver review are context, not adopted original validation theorems.
Seventh-order iterations, plasma eigenproblems and non-rigorous acceleration studies do not supply the requested full-box certificate.
Dahmen-Gruber-Mula radiative transfer entry had abstract-only access here; no theorem application is claimed.
coverage_limit: Targeted search sufficient to attribute the standard mathematical tools. It does not establish absence of other work or a novelty/no-go claim for the full physical model.
raw_cache_publication_note: Exact original tool results are kept outside the public work tree because they contain lengthy source text. Public records bind them by size/hash and record actual query inputs and reading scope.
